pairs: Verbum Domini quod factum est ad Sophoniam, filium Chusi,
The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi,
in the days of Josiah the son of Amon,
Congregans congregabo omnia a facie terræ,
While gathering, I will gather together all things from the face of the earth,
I will gather man and cattle;
congregans volatilia cæli et pisces maris:
I will gather the flying things of the air and the fish of the sea.
And the impious will be a catastrophe.
et disperdam homines a facie terræ,
And I will disperse men before the face of the earth,
Et extendam manum meam super Judam et super omnes habitantes Jerusalem:
And I will extend my hand over Judah and over all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
et disperdam de loco hoc reliquias Baal,
And I will disperse from this place the remnant of Baal,
and the names of the administrators along with the priests,
et eos qui adorant super tecta militiam cæli,
and those who adore the military campaign over the ceiling of the sky,
et adorant et jurant in Domino,
both those who adore and swear by the Lord,
and those who swear by Melchom,
et qui avertuntur de post tergum Domini,
both those who turn aside from following after the Lord,
and those who have not sought the Lord,
Be silent before the face of the Lord God.
For the day of the Lord is near;
for the Lord has prepared a victim,
he has sanctified those he has called.
in the day of the victim of the Lord,
I will visit upon the leaders,
and upon the sons of the king,
et super omnes qui induti sunt veste peregrina;
and upon all who have been clothed with strange garments.
et visitabo super omnem qui arroganter ingreditur super limen in die illa,
And I will visit upon all who enter arrogantly over the threshold in that day,
qui complent domum Domini Dei sui iniquitate et dolo.
those who fill the house of the Lord their God with iniquity and deceit.
And this shall be in that day,
the voice of an outcry from the fish gate,
and a howling from the Second,
and a great contrition from the hills.
All the people of Canaan have fallen silent.
All were ruined who had been wrapped in silver.
And this shall be in that time:
I will scrutinize Jerusalem with lamps,
et visitabo super viros defixos in fæcibus suis,
and I will visit upon the men who have become stuck in the dregs,
and he will not do evil.”
Et erit fortitudo eorum in direptionem,
And their strength will be in plundering,
and their houses in the desert.
The great day of the Lord is near;
The voice of the day of the Lord is bitter;
the strong will be tested there.
That day is a day of wrath,
a day of tribulation and anguish,
a day of calamity and misery,
a day of darkness and gloom,
a day of clouds and whirlwinds,
dies tubæ et clangoris super civitates munitas, et super angulos excelsos.
a day of the trumpet and the trumpet blast over fortified cities and over exalted ramparts.
and they will walk like the blind,
because they have sinned against the Lord.
et effundetur sanguis eorum sicut humus,
And their blood will be poured out like soil,
Sed et argentum eorum et aurum eorum non poterit liberare eos in die iræ Domini:
Neither their silver, nor their gold, will be able to free them in the day of the wrath of the Lord.
in igne zeli ejus devorabitur omnis terra,
All the land will be devoured in the fire of his zeal,
quia consummationem cum festinatione faciet cunctis habitantibus terram.
for with all speed, he will bring to consummation every inhabitant of the land.
